correctness.rationale: Applied Ind_2 condition every induced connected component has ≤2 vertices iff every induced degree≤1. Independently scanned all 2^17 subsets and found 868 faces including empty; f=(17,136,340,306,68), facets 34 size4 and 68 size5. Independent element-toggle Morse matching has 423 disjoint pairs, critical 1 vertex, 1 two-cell, 19 three-cells, and is acyclic over all face incidences. Independently evaluated signed Morse projection with unit pivots; the nineteen critical attaching degrees are 0 except -1 at masks 67620,69728,99360. A degree-one 3-cell kills the only S2 and other 18 attach nullhomotopically, proving ∨18 S3 integrally, not just modularly. No nonzero face is fixed setwise by nonidentity translation of order17; Lefschetz trace on H3 is 1 for nonidentity,18 at identity, giving Q⊕Q[C17].
